_comment: NSE F&O lot sizes (from Fyers symbol master) + strike steps. Refresh lots with: python scripts/fetch_lot_sizes.py
_index_trail_comment: Underlying index-point exits for intraday call-buying (Reversal5m, InstitutionalMomentum learning). sl = initial stop in index points below entry; trail = points below running peak to ratchet the stop. Tuned on 90d 5m backtest 2026-06.
_index_exit_mode_comment: Per-index option exit for Reversal5m (90d 5m backtest): underlying_breakdown = hard SL + exit when a red 5m candle closes below the prior 5m low (best for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY); underlying_trail = ratcheting points trail (best for FINNIFTY).
